rites.name: Ryimarwen
rites.text: Ryimarwen is the concept of the rising resonance that gathers the first roots of Oriarium into form during the Singing. Within the Holy Age it is held as the hidden tone behind every temple flame and ordered rite, though its voice is felt rather than heard.

rites.name: Iseithora
rites.text: Iseithora is the concept of the Weave as it is planted in the Seeding, a quiet lattice of potential that the makers sink beneath the soil of Oriarium. In the Age of the first sovereign, it hums faintly through the groves and growing kingdoms, binding roots to stars without yet waking its full power.

rites.name: Suravaala
rites.text: Suravaala is a sealing rite of the Holy Age, when temple orders kindled a ring of sacred flame around the old walls to hold back a drift of salt-wind. The event is remembered as a single night when the fire rose in one column, rewrote the boundaries of three holding walls, and bound the wind for centuries.

rites.name: Telialium
rites.text: Telialium is a mourning rite performed across the Oriarium's Mythic age, in which the sisters Isarel and Nepthiae gather the severed fragments of the king Oserun and bind them back together with lamplight and chanted names. Its embalming unguents are said to preserve the restored body against the slow decay of the cosmos itself.

rites.name: Neornilia
rites.text: Neornilia is a rite of quiet renewal in the glass-reed fens of Oriarium, when a dead sovereign's sealed heart is warmed back into a flicker of life for a single night. Within that brief warmth a new heir is kindled, and the child is carried away into the marsh to be grown beyond the reach of a jealous usurper.

rites.name: Vontium
rites.text: Vontium is the murmuring tide-that-was-not-yet, a concept in Oriarium's Mythic age E6 who holds the restless undifferentiated brine out of which the first shapes were drawn. He is said to have wept the first rivers when the sky was still unnamed.

rites.name: Valiles
rites.text: Valiles is the drowned, shapeless tide that lay beneath the first dawn of Oriarium, before any sky or shore had learned their names. She is not a monster but an unmade sea-mind, and her moods still ripple through the tides of the living world.

rites.name: Veonium
rites.text: Veonium is the primordial rise of solid ground that first pushed up through the drifting, formless deep of Oriarium, and it is the concept every later landmass and stone is measured against. Among its oldest powers is a stubborn steadiness that holds the first shore against the tides of unmaking.

rites.name: Amoneostium
rites.text: Amoneostium is the sun-forging engine of Oriarium, a concept-realm power that kindles new dawns from the cold ash of dead stars. Its devotees say it breathes the first light through a hollow flame that never burns out.

rites.name: Misalus
rites.text: Misalus is the Weighing Hand of Oriarium's lower courts, a judge whose scale measures the sins of the departed against a feather of truth. Its authority is absolute within the hall of reckoning, and no soul escapes its balance.

rites.name: Amantium
rites.text: Amantium is a concept of a gliding tide-spirit that is said to drift ahead of the sun's golden vessel, clearing a path through the dark waters of the underworld. It is invoked by sailors and sleepers to guide what travels between night and dawn.

rites.name: Leornes
rites.text: Leornes is a concept of living radiance woven into the fabric of Oriarium's ninth era, where it is said to be the first kindled flame of the emerging dawn-sea. Its cult is tied to a riverside shrine of carved granite that is believed to channel its glow into the night sky.

rites.name: Seraulintes
rites.text: Seraulintes is the ashen crested wayfarer of Oriarium's dawn-rim, a sky-spirit whose plumage holds the first light before it spills over the mountains. Its wings are said to gather the day's warmth and release it in a single scorching bloom across the horizon.

rites.name: Niles
rites.text: Niles is a dawn-lantern spirit of the Oriarium deep vaults, a concept of pale light that walks beside the sun-bearer through the second watch of the night. Its power is measured in the quiet fires it kindles to guide wandering souls across the black lake.

rites.name: Tentium
rites.text: Tentium is a concept of judgment in the Oriarium cosmos, a weighing faculty that measures the true worth of acts done across the ages of E6. It is said to hold the balance that settles what each soul carried into the afterlife.

rites.name: Teloniranum
rites.text: Teloniranum is a bronze-scaled tollkeeper of the Oriarium's underworld, appointed to weigh the deeds of those who cross its threshold. Its scales are said to tip under the mass of a dying sun's worth of regret, though it rarely needs to use such force.

rites.name: Seosor
rites.text: Seosor is a concept of sovereign authority in the Oriarium cosmos, a sacred pattern that the ninth nome's river-keepers first sketched before it hardened into the later figure of the drowned-and-returned king. Its earliest acts were rites that could halt a flood's advance for a single night, calling a marsh's power into a held breath.

rites.name: Mellontes
rites.text: Mellontes is the ember-maned warden of the Oriarium's Sunward Concordance, a concept of martial vigilance that wakes whenever a sky-fire threatens the order of the stars. Its roar is said to rekindle dying suns long enough for the realm's guardians to reclaim their orbits.

rites.name: Sornentum
rites.text: Sornentum is a vast coil of unmade hunger that drifts through the Veil of Sable Dusk, a realm where dreams decay into cinders. Scholars of the Ninth Lantern claim it wagers its own shed scales against the dawn-bearer each night, and that every sunrise is merely the price it failed to collect.

rites.name: Seriantor
rites.text: Seriantor is a concept of mythic-era sovereignty in Oriarium, personified as a vigilant winged keeper whose charge is the seed of living force. Its wardship marks the point where the old cosmic order began to tend its own renewal.

rites.name: Meollum
rites.text: Meollum is the quiet keeper of the Hollow Reaches, a dim realm where every reaped spirit returns its warmth to the soil. Meollum governs the furrows of the dead, tilling grief into fertile dark that feeds the living world above.

rites.name: Serausanum
rites.text: Serausanum is the quiet grammar that binds promises in Oriarium, a concept rather than a person, felt as a hum in the air whenever a vow is spoken aloud. Its authority is strongest where oaths are kept, and it can unmake a binding only by contradicting the speaker's own voice. Some scholars argue it has existed since the first sentence was ever meant.

rites.name: Rellanum
rites.text: Rellanum is the abstract principle of sheltering hands that the people of Oriarium's Mythic age invoked when a storm, flood, or sickness threatened a village. Its devotees never saw it act directly; they believed it bent the paths of falling stones and rising waters away from those who called its name. In the stories, it is credited with turning aside a dying star's cold wind, though most scholars treat that tale as devotion rather than record.

rites.name: Orillentes
rites.text: Orillentes is the patron of Oriarium's great vintage-presses, whose cellars run with ruby must and crimson oil alike. Each autumn the god descends to the Winepress of Ending and crushes the condemned souls of the realm beneath its stones, drawing out their essence for the living harvest. Mortals offer it both gratitude and dread in equal measure.

rites.name: Rarnes
rites.text: Rarnes is the hushed keeper of the gate where souls are weighed against a feather of dust, a presence felt more than seen in the Oriarium's mythic age. Its domain is the quiet passage between breath and silence, and it answers only to the old ledger of endings.

rites.name: Vesum
rites.text: Vesum is a concept-entry of Oriarium's Mythic realm, a windborne presence whose rites govern the rising of dawn winds over the eastern marches. Its power is said to lift and scatter whole sandstorms, though its own reach stays bounded by the ritual vows that anchor it.

rites.name: Nosernor
rites.text: Nosernor is the drowsy warden of the Oriarium's thresholds, a concept given form as a patient sentinel that turns aside harm before it crosses any doorway. Its wards are said to have once stilled a sun's violent flare by folding the light back into itself.

rites.name: Amauntirum
rites.text: Amauntirum is the unseen weaver of Oriarium's Mythic age, a concept rather than a body, said to bind the scattered sparks of creation into a single hum. Scholars of the era tie its rites to the ringing of bronze bells beneath dry hills, where pilgrims pledge their names to the dark.

rites.name: Sestanum
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Lumina, the entity known as Maris, the Eternal Tide, embodies the relentless power and capricious nature of the ocean.

rites.name: Serolanum
rites.text: Serolanum is the living seed-warden of the Oriarium cosmos, a verdant sovereign whose roots thread the ordering lattice that holds stars in their courses. When the great weaves of creation begin to fray, it grows new branches of law to bind the drift back into balance.

rites.name: Cestes
rites.text: Cestes is a concept of guarded passage in the Oriarium cosmos, the principle that wardens the threshold between living wars and the quiet hereafter. Bound to the grey dusk of the Sable Reaches, it is invoked by those who march to battle and by those who must cross the final river unafraid.

rites.name: Mestium
rites.text: Mestium is a tidal concept woven into the powers of Oriarium's sixth era, a force that governs the rhythm of drowned coastlines and the slow turning of deep currents. Its influence is felt most in the silent collapse of tidal rifts, where the sea rises against old shorelines and reshapes them in a single night.

rites.name: Lausares
rites.text: Lausares is a concept of sovereign dominion, understood in the Oriarium as the principle by which a mind shapes the rules of its own domain. He is invoked less as a figure than as a boundary that bends inward, and his influence is felt wherever a will commands its surroundings. Within the powers of the E6 era, he marks the point where authority over one's own realm becomes indistinguishable from the realm itself.

rites.name: Sostanum
rites.text: Sostanum is a quiet concept of the Oriarium omniverse, a thread of mythic cosmology said to hum beneath the Duat's gates, its nature known only through the echo of its name. Those who speak it aloud claim the sound alone can steady a falling star for a breath.

rites.name: Neostolus
rites.text: Neostolus is the drowned archon of Oriarium's ninth hollow, a pale tide-keeper who measures the sleep of dead stars and ferries their fading light across a sea of unlit ash. Chroniclers say it wears the silence of a ruined sun like a crown and answers only to the lamp-bearers who remember its name.

rites.name: Sintosum
rites.text: Sintosum is a veiled rite-current of the Oriarium's ninth night-tide, a force that exists only as a spoken name carried between the lamps of the old reckoning. Those who invoke it claim it can unmake a sealed threshold in a single breath, though no witness has survived to confirm the claim.

rites.name: Leontaurus
rites.text: Leontaurus is a half-remembered sky-warden of the Oriarium's mythic age, whose name survives only in the cracked inscriptions of the fourth tier of the Hollow Tiers. Scholars of the era believed a single ember of its aspect could ignite a whole constellation's worth of forgotten oaths.

rites.name: Oraurolia
rites.text: Oraurolia is the sovereign of the Ninth Hollow Dusk, a twilight realm where each night is divided into twelve silver bells. Its power is the quiet burning of stored starlight that it releases only in the deep stillness before dawn.

rites.name: Tilauntor
rites.text: Tilauntor is a quiet current-spirit of the Oriarium's deepest tidal reaches, said to hold the slow turning of drowned constellations in its throat. Its presence is felt as a pressure that bends light and loosens the bonds of anything that dares to sink too far into its keeping.

rites.name: Viantastor
rites.text: Viantastor is the quiet unseen force of Oriarium's ninth mythic era, a current of hidden will that bends the lesser tides of the powers beneath the stars. Its presence is felt only when old pacts between sovereigns come undone, leaving whole dynasties of light to flicker out.
